meta.project_name: EduX AI Smart Faculty & Timetable Planner
notes: password_hash fields are SHA-256 of a dummy raw password for seed/demo purposes only — use bcrypt in production.
mobile numbers are randomly generated dummy 10-digit numbers, not real.

weekly_periods per subject is kept in the 2-4 range (theory) / 2-4 (lab) so that the SUM of weekly_periods across all subjects offered to one division in one semester stays within the realistic 24-36 slot/week capacity (6 periods x 6 days = 36 max slots). A single subject cannot itself consume 24-36 periods — that would make scheduling impossible — so that constraint is applied at the division-week level, not the per-subject level.
teacher current_assigned_hours / remaining_capacity are computed from teacher_subject_mapping workload (weekly_periods * number of divisions assigned).

hard_constraints: Same teacher cannot teach multiple divisions at the same time slot
Same classroom cannot be booked for multiple classes at the same time slot
Same laboratory cannot host multiple sessions at the same time slot
Teacher workload should not fall below min_hours_per_week (24) where possible
Lab sessions require consecutive periods equal to lab_duration_slots
A division cannot have the same subject scheduled twice on the same day
soft_constraints: Balance teacher workload evenly across available teachers
Spread subjects evenly through the week rather than clustering
Avoid back-to-back heavy theory lectures for the same division
Prefer teacher's declared availability and preferred_slots
Prefer the primary teacher (is_primary_teacher=true) before secondary teachers
Automatically fall back to replacement_priority list if the primary teacher is unavailable
